summary_en: This phase II trial tests temozolomide and radiation therapy in adults with IDH wildtype gliomas, including IDH wildtype glioblastoma. Patients take temozolomide by mouth daily during 6 weeks of radiation therapy given 5 days a week, then continue temozolomide by mouth for 12 months if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a phase II trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II estudia temozolomida y radioterapia en adultos con gliomas IDH wildtype, incluido el glioblastoma IDH wildtype. Los pacientes toman temozolomida por vía oral todos los días durante 6 semanas de radioterapia, administrada 5 días a la semana, y luego continúan con temozolomida por vía oral durante 12 meses si la enfermedad no progresa y la toxicidad es aceptable. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; este es un ensayo de fase II.
who_for: IDH wildtype glioma, per the listed historical grade II or III or molecular glioblastoma definitions
Karnofsky performance status of 70 or higher within 30 days before enrollment
Post-operative MRI with contrast is required for radiation planning
Blood counts, liver and kidney tests within set limits within 60 days before registration
not_for: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for any brain tumor
Prior cranial or head and neck radiation with possible field overlap
Severe active comorbidity, such as recent heart problems, or HIV with CD4 count under 200 cells/microliter
